items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: In fact Goz was my closest friend. I’m his first child’s Godfather.

ctx.x: Is that what you called him? You called him Goz?
Yeah Gozzo. Conrad Gozzo. I called him Goz. In fact Goz was my closest friend. I’m his first child’s Godfather.
Oh. Now in that trumpet section, Conrad was lead? Were you the hot man? Did you split it?
